content.jointProblem: Can the researcher's downscaling and geostatistical interpolation methods be adapted to MeteoVoj's 5 km daily weather grids to produce field-level hail-intensity proxies that link to policy locations and reveal farm-property segments priced too low? The first test would compare candidate proxies against the three years of geo-tagged hail claims and quantify whether the spatial signal is strong enough to justify integration into the quarterly pricing pipeline.

rationale.text: Has produced 1 km climate fields for the Vojvodina plain by combining satellite land-surface temperature with station observations, directly relevant to downscaling coarse weather grids.

sources.quote: Monthly mean air temperature fields at 1 km resolution were produced for the Vojvodina plain by combining MODIS Terra LST composites

rationale.text: Has evaluated kriging variants for daily precipitation, including external-drift kriging that improved on ordinary kriging, relevant to spatial interpolation of storm-related fields.

sources.quote: KED using terrain-exposed elevation as the external drift variable outperformed OK in 73 % of daily cases

rationale.text: Has built parcel-scale hazard maps by combining downscaled temperature grids with topographic indices, a transferable template for field-level hazard mapping.

sources.quote: A spatial frost risk index (FRI) was developed by combining downscaled minimum temperature grids at 250 m resolution

rationale.text: Has delivered an open-source Python processing chain and Web Map Service, relevant to automating a pricing-model feed.

sources.quote: a Web Map Service interface, and a documented open-source Python processing chain

risks: Hail-specific transfer is unproven: the nearest evidence covers temperature downscaling, daily precipitation kriging, frost risk and drought, not hail intensity.
Narrow, fast-moving hailstorms may be under-resolved by 5 km daily grids, even after downscaling.
Settlement-level farm addresses may introduce location error larger than field-level hail gradients.
MeteoVoj variables, licensing and whether any hail or convective diagnostics exist are unknown.
Integration with the legacy on-premise Guidewire instance and a small split-capacity IT team may delay deployment.
Publication/IP disagreements could block start, and the researcher's availability is unknown.
